_schema_help.question: What exact visual values must all screens and components reuse?
_schema_help.status: Owner-chosen Stage 5 foundation 'Material Lean' (UX-005-03), recorded in analysis/prototyping/ui-ux-decision.md decision version 1. The owner's choice («Поехали. Мне нравится», ekzarov, relayed by Codex) covers this foundation only; it approves no screen, component variant or function.
_schema_help.ownership: Stage 5 UX author records the chosen foundation; Stage 6 maintains extensions. The owner decides at Stages 5 and 8.
_schema_help.modes: Light theme only. A dark theme and a comfortable-density option are possible later but are not approved; adding either is a foundation change that returns to Stage 5.
_schema_help.units: Dimensions use rem (1rem = 16px at default browser text size) so that user text-size settings scale the interface.
_schema_help.consumption: The catalogue uses property=token.name bindings. audit:prototype checks types, aliases, pins and references once a manifest exists; rendered tests check visual correctness.
_schema_help.foundation: The canonical foundation digest is printed by node analysis/tools/ui-design-system.js and pinned once in ui-ux-decision.md. Any change to this object prints a new digest and returns to Stage 5.
_schema_help.extensions: Empty at Stage 5. Stage 6 adds only tokens that agreed scenarios need (for example breakpoints, overlay shadow, a danger hover) within this foundation, for owner approval at Stage 8.

foundation.component_library: Framework-neutral shared component catalogue (ui-design-system.md) in the light minimalist Material style 'Material Lean'; no Material library is selected; the implementation adapter is chosen with the architecture at Stage 9
foundation.icon_set: Lucide (icon-only only for familiar tool actions with an accessible name and tooltip; business commands are labeled with text; subject to Stage 9 platform compatibility)

font.body.value: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
